reviewer: Kimi actually viewed the exact original 65x67 source and NEAREST 8x source page including its note region, the unchanged full external-06 raw master, native note crop (1040,970,400,220), full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-mode sheet and unchanged mascot reference. The exact original has TWO separated irregular gray-mark groups in the upper note row and TWO in the lower row, plus a compact right-edge tab. The return instead has a series of distinct repeated short blobs in both rows. Actual image metadata and the complete comparison confirm an RGB return with no alpha channel, not native transparency. The earlier review's alpha interpretation and precise returned-group counts are not used as this decision's evidence. Task/prompt/request/result and output SHA bindings were checked.

remaining_reasons: The exact source has TWO separated irregular gray-mark groups in its upper note row and TWO separated irregular gray-mark groups in its lower row. External-06 instead has a series of distinct repeated short blobs in both rows, not those two-plus-two source groups. Restore exactly TWO source-scale separated irregular groups in EACH row, with original relative lengths and compact footprint. Do not substitute generic repeated dots or readable writing; keep the lower paper blank and preserve the restored compact right-edge tab at its existing correct position and scale.

The actual returned PNG is RGB with no alpha channel, while the original has a genuinely transparent exterior around the complete card/frame/note silhouette. A future repair must return genuine native RGBA transparency outside the complete silhouette while preserving the opaque person, photographic backing, frame and note interior. Do not substitute an opaque working matte or claim that the missing alpha channel was verified as genuine transparency. No alpha-only repair is authorized while the note RGB is rejected.

hair_features.reason: The high receding crown, short dark side/back hair and sideburn, one visible dark brow and clean-shaven profile chin remain without an invented beard or headgear.

collar_fit.reason: The olive high collar fits a short broad neck transition without a pinched collar, long neck column, floating cloth or cream bib.

entries.positive_observation: The strict single-eye left profile is restored with a green-ringed black eye, one serious mouth and short side/back hair. The olive uniform retains pale collar patches, neck cross, shoulder braid and note-clipped decorations. The tilted frame, photographic backing and compact right-edge note tab remain. The note's group structure and the missing native alpha channel nevertheless prevent approval.
entries.alpha_decision: The returned image is 2048x2048 RGB with no alpha channel; alpha extrema and alpha counts are null. The source is RGBA with extrema 0..255 and real exterior transparency. The current output cannot receive visible-alpha approval or be described as having genuine exterior transparency. Preserve the historical records, but do not reuse the earlier review's contrary alpha description. This rejection also includes the visible note defect, so no deterministic alpha-only substitution is authorized.
entries.visible_limitations: Possible tiny eyewear/temple details, individual breast decorations and note glyph identities cannot be resolved at 65x67 and are not rejection grounds. The rejection relies on plainly visible repeated groups replacing the source's two-plus-two group structure and the directly verified absence of an alpha channel, not guessed text.
